items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen when walking 10 to 19 minutes after dinner. Walking after dinner went with a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a rise in sugar, with sugar rising about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference for you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Having an overnight fast of 13 hours or more is part of the coaching, and your overnight fast averaged 14.5 hours. In the program, adding the overnight fast to coaching changed the results by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
